name: Compagnie de l'Odet
summary: Compagnie de l'Odet engages in oil, communication, and industry business in France, Africa, the Americas, the Asia-Pacific, and other European countries. The company involved in the distribution and warehousing of oil products. It also engages in the pay and free TV and production, the sale and distribution of cinema films and TV series, the design and release of downloadable video games on mobile devices and consoles, ticketing and venue services, communications consulting and advertising agencies, magazine sales, sales of goods and circulation of publications, travel retail sales, and sales of licenses and subscription services.
